assertions.title: Bare no-input MCP object schemas remain callable for OpenAI-compatible tool use

steps.action: Attempt to register local validation MCP servers on 192.168.50.4:8765 and :8766 to expose no-input/open-object tools
steps.expected: Local MCP servers register and expose no-input plus open-object schema tools for callable-path verification
steps.observed: Both POST /api/mcp/servers calls returned 403 MCP_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED for http://192.168.50.4:8765 and :8766.

steps.action: Probe current MCP inventory and callable tool surface
steps.expected: Inventory includes candidate no-input/open-object MCP tools and callable OpenAI-compatible tool path
steps.observed: Inventory only showed ollama_search_fetch (query/url-required tools); GET /api/agents/tools returned SSE payload `event: error {"message":"Illegal request"}` rather than a callable tool execution surface.

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed on MCP panel capture

assertions.issues: Blocked: required no-input/open-object MCP test servers were rejected by MCP domain policy, and no equivalent callable user-surface path was available for this assertion.

assertions.title: OAuth refresh prefers protected-resource authorization server metadata

steps.action: Create and initialize Arcade OAuth MCP server
steps.expected: OAuth-capable server is available and can be put into a token-refresh test state
steps.observed: Arcade server creation succeeded (201, requiresOAuth=true) and reinitialize returned OAuth URL plus pending state.

steps.action: Probe OAuth status for refresh preconditions
steps.expected: Have an expired/refreshable token state to validate refresh-endpoint selection behavior
steps.observed: OAuth status remained PENDING (no completed auth/token), so refresh path could not be exercised.

assertions.issues: Blocked: no authorized/expired OAuth token state was available, so token refresh behavior could not be validated.

assertions.title: OAuth callback URLs preserve precedence rules across local and proxied deployments

steps.action: Trigger OAuth initiate route with direct and forwarded header variants
steps.expected: Callback URL host/protocol precedence can be observed from initiate response/redirect
steps.observed: Both direct and forwarded GET /api/mcp/:server/oauth/initiate returned 404 Flow not found.

steps.action: Compare reinitialize OAuth URL behavior direct vs forwarded
steps.expected: Forwarded-host/proto variant should produce observable callback-host precedence behavior
steps.observed: Direct reinitialize returned oauthUrl with localhost callback; forwarded reinitialize returned success:false and no oauthUrl, leaving precedence unverified.

assertions.issues: Blocked: callback precedence rules were not conclusively observable because initiate required missing flow state and forwarded reinitialize did not return an OAuth URL.

assertions.title: Arcade provider-consent prompts are surfaced as auth continuation, not MCP init failure

steps.action: Initialize Arcade MCP server before consent
steps.expected: Server remains available and returns auth-continuation metadata rather than hard init failure
steps.observed: Reinitialize returned success:true and oauthUrl (`ready for OAuth authentication`), indicating continuation metadata at initialization boundary.

steps.action: Exercise concrete tool invocation continuation payload path
steps.expected: Tool invocation returns authorization_url and/or llm_instructions continuation metadata when consent is pending
steps.observed: Concrete interactive MCP tool invocation path was not reachable in this run (agent tool endpoint returned Illegal request SSE payload and browser flow hit temporary-ban friction).

assertions.issues: Blocked: initialization continuation evidence exists, but required concrete tool-invocation continuation payload could not be captured from the available user-surface path.

assertions.title: Scheduled MCP and OAuth execution keeps the interactive auth contract

steps.action: Create OAuth-required Arcade MCP server and reinitialize to pending-consent state
steps.expected: Server is OAuth-gated and pending authorization before schedule execution
steps.observed: Arcade server created (201 requiresOAuth=true), reinitialize returned oauthUrl with localhost callback, connection state showed requiresOAuth=true/connecting.

steps.action: Create schedule targeting openAI model with ephemeralAgent.mcp=[arcade-microsoft-tools] and run now
steps.expected: Pending-consent MCP/OAuth should be rechecked and run should fail durably (not silent success)
steps.observed: Run-now returned 200 success with `lastStatus: succeeded`, conversation created, and generic assistant reply instead of explicit MCP/OAuth failure.

steps.action: Cleanup temporary schedule and MCP server
steps.observed: Schedule deleted (204). MCP server delete returned 200 and required a retry verification pass; final MCP inventory/connection showed only ollama_search_fetch.

assertions.issues: Fail: pending-consent OAuth MCP path did not cause explicit durable schedule failure; execution succeeded and produced a normal conversation response.
